pendingChecks.label: Verify installed PHP matches intended plugin
steps: The deployed 0.1.2 PHP/CSS lacks the 0.1.3 context/category restrictions; no cross-client leak has been observed.
Prepare an isolated test store and confirm four templates, categories, related products, history widget, draft permissions, cart/checkout and mobile layout.
Back up both existing plugin files and validate 0.1.3 plus rollback; obtain owner approval before live update.
pendingChecks.notPermitted: Do not update/deactivate the live plugin as a diagnostic.

pendingChecks.label: Choose exactly one authoritative SKU generator
steps: Custom builder and SkyVerge register conflicting write paths; WP Wham is active as a plugin but internal generation was off at audit.
Protect custom builder's state-changing GET rebuild with a nonce/POST design before any authorized rebuild.
On isolated fixtures test create, edit, AJAX variations, REST and bulk; choose one authority and preserve previous Woo IDs, jobs and blank mappings.
Never assume SKU regeneration syncs Supabase or fixes blank master links.
pendingChecks.notPermitted: Do not regenerate, disable plugins, change SKU or execute bulk repair on production.

The owner confirmed the 100% discount/free-shipping coupon is intentional. Preserve it unchanged. Intended audience and optional safeguards are a separate confidential policy topic.
Define intended campaign delivery/free-shipping exceptions. Some classes intentionally charge $0; Heavy fallback class is blank.
Test 199.99, 200.00, 200.01 with coupons/tax/classes/zones before any changes.
